usageNotes: Retrieves the full configuration of a single SDN fabric by its ID, including protocol type (openfabric, ospf, wireguard, or bgp) and all protocol-specific properties. Use this before issuing an update to capture the current `digest` value, which acts as an optimistic concurrency lock to prevent overwriting concurrent changes. Requires either SDN.Audit or SDN.Allocate on the fabric's ACL path; API tokens are supported.

examples.summary: Fetch configuration for an OSPF fabric named 'dc1fab'

tips: The `digest` field in the response should be passed back in any subsequent update call to guard against concurrent modification.

Protocol-specific fields (e.g. `area` for ospf, `csnp_interval`/`hello_interval` for openfabric, `persistent_keepalive` for wireguard) are only present when the fabric's `protocol` matches their `instance-types`.
The fabric `id` must be 2–8 alphanumeric characters (hyphens allowed in the middle); exact pattern is `[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9-]{0,6}[a-zA-Z0-9]`.
A `lock-token` in the response indicates the global SDN configuration is currently locked; avoid writes until it clears.
